extraction.NOTES: Source: split from multi-allottee bundle (part2_agency_narrative_034.json) on 2026-05-03 using Sonnet vision extraction. Allotment 813. Patent date: 1920-03-12. Patent number: 739643. Mechanism: administrative. Buyer: Ed Haisch. Sale price: $1.00 and other valuable consideration. Land: northwest quarter of section 24, township 43, range 27 (adjacent to Harry Moran's allotment 812). Sold to Ed Haisch for nominal consideration. Patent issued same day as sibling allotment 812. Likely family relationship between Harry and Narcisse Moran given adjacent allotments and shared surname. Sibling record (other allottee in original bundle): part2_agency_narrative_034a.json. Vision extraction archived at: validation_samples/part2_agency_narrative_034_vision/vision_merged.json.
